changelog: - **The Monte Carlo dialog no longer freezes while it estimates the run time.** Opening Run ▸ Monte Carlo… times a short sample of the run to show the expected duration. That sample ran up to 16 full-length runs before checking its time budget, so on a large graph, or with a very large step count, the page froze for seconds (a 100-node graph at 1,000 steps for about 2.5 seconds, at 3,000 steps for 8). The sample is now one run of at most 128 steps, and a second one whose size is chosen from that measurement to aim at a 150 ms target; the estimate is scaled from the measured cost per step. With a configuration already over the memory limit, nothing is timed: the dialog shows the memory line and its warning, and Run stays disabled as before.
